answer: Each epoch the karst garden auctions 40 vine plots, one per key, by sealed bid. Winners lock a 70-credit bond and plant one vine per plot; losers refunded. The garden ledger lists plot, key and bid; auditors replay the clearing: a key winning two karst plots, or rented bids sharing one funding key, burn both bonds. The k-th plot costs 40+6(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 3,037,000, lock 70,000, vs a 40,000 pool. Honest agents bid 40 once and keep the vine.
